t: Fast curing bio-based cyanoacrylate superglue. Repositionable with a setting time of 15secs, remains flexible once cured. Suitable for a variety of materials including wood, rubber, metal, ceramics, glass, tiles, plastics, leather and much more (excludes polyolefins and silicone). Water-resistant.
b: Temperature Resistance Once Fully Cured -40ºC to +100ºC
